unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
validation: Some of the entered data is not valid.
http-400: The request could not be processed.
http-403: You do not have access to this.

http-500: The server ran into a problem. Please try again later.
no-waiver-published: No liability waiver has been published yet.
waiver-birth-date-required: Add the sailor's date of birth first — it decides whether a guardian has to sign.

guardian-name-required: Enter the name of the guardian who signed.
waiver-already-confirmed: This sailor has already confirmed version {required_version} of the waiver for this competition.
waiver-confirmation-forbidden: You can only confirm the waiver for your own account.
waiver-checklist-forbidden: The check-in list is available to the event organizer and the league office.

race-result-duplicate-position: Finish position {finish_position} is used by more than one boat.
no-linked-person-record: No person record is linked to this account yet — it is once your address is confirmed. Sign in once with a code, or ask the league office.

sailor-photo-invalid-type: The upload must be an image.
sailor-photo-invalid: This file is not a readable image.

squad-unknown-sailor: Some of these people no longer exist. Reload the page.

waiver-scan-too-large: The file is too large — at most 10 MB.

waiver-scan-not-found: No signed form is on file for this confirmation.

active-club-not-mine: You can only act for a club you belong to or organize.

last-organizer: At least one admin must remain for this club.

tuple-object-missing: The club, series or event does not exist.

tuple-self-lockout: You cannot revoke your own admin role.
tuple-forbidden: Only administration or the object's managers may change who has access to it.

password-email-unverified: Confirm your email address with a one-time code before setting a password.
password-current-wrong: The current password is not correct.
password-login-disabled: Signing in with a password is switched off on this site.

expense-item-unknown: That item is not on this claim.

iban-invalid: This IBAN is not valid — check it for a typing error.
documents-forbidden: These documents are shown only to their owner and their organizers.
document-invalid: This file could not be read.

document-too-large: The document is too large (at most 10 MB).
expense-document-invalid: This receipt could not be read.
expense-document-invalid-type: A receipt must be a PDF, a JPEG or a PNG.

claim-not-payable: One of the claims is not approved, belongs to another club, or has nothing left to pay.
payment-run-not-found: This payment run does not exist.
payment-not-failable: Only a payment sent to the bank or booked can come back.
bic-invalid: This BIC is not valid — leave it empty to take it from the IBAN.

guardian-link-forbidden: Only the manager or admin of the sailor's club can link a guardian.
guardian-account-missing: There is no account with this address — the parent registers first.
guardian-is-the-sailor: A sailor cannot be their own guardian.
guardian-link-missing: This sailor has no such guardian.
waiver-ward-is-adult: This sailor is an adult for this competition and accepts the waiver themselves.
forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.

token-invalid: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Please sign in again.

test-account-not-found: This test account does not exist.

login-account-unknown: There is no account for this address. Please contact the league office.

team-not-in-event: This team is not entered in this event.
sailor-not-found: This person could not be found.
email-taken: Someone with the address {email} already exists. Addresses are unique.

club-not-in-event: This club does not take part in this event.
lineup-duplicate-person: A person is lined up twice.
